title: Is The AI Bubble About to Pop? | Business With Brian's Top Stocks to Watch
creator: BWB - Business With Brian
source_note: Detailed summary generated from video captions; note: captions garbled in places; collab hosted by The Mispriced Podcast (host Eli)
summary: In a collaboration with The Mispriced Podcast (host Eli), Brian tackles whether we are in an AI bubble. He says no: unlike the dot-com era, today's spending is backed by real demand and hyperscalers investing for return on investment, with the AI build-out at only about 1.5-2% of GDP, and AI's productivity gains still mostly ahead. The key theme is bottlenecks — wherever customers pre-book capacity years ahead, a constraint exists — above all memory, where buyers now commit $30B and book 2-3 years out, and connectors shifting from copper to photonics. On Micron, he says the run has been so high and so fast it is scary: trim at all-time highs, but do not sell completely, since memory bookings may break the old cycle and a $30B buyback is coming in December. He calls SanDisk the highest risk of flash price compression as planned capacity exceeds demand. For a friend's top-three watchlist he names Nvidia as the anchor ('don't bet against Nvidia... a slam dunk', PE below the S&P 500, PEG below 1), TSMC as a very solid choice despite Taiwan/China risk, and Broadcom at fair value; the SMH ETF is the 'perfect option' for new investors. Eli adds that if there is a bubble it is in earnings, with the S&P 500 PE near 18.7. Calls: NVDA BUY (flip from CONDITIONAL_BUY earlier today), TSM BUY, AVGO BUY, SMH BUY (all reiterated), MU SELL/trim (flip from CONDITIONAL_BUY), SNDK AVOID (flip from CONDITIONAL_BUY).
